column.name: description
column.value: Три формы самых частых неправильных глаголов

changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO card (deck_id, type, question, answer, created_at, updated_at) SELECT d.id, 'NORMAL', v.question, v.answer, now(), now() FROM deck d JOIN (VALUES (1, 'go', 'went, gone'), (2, 'be', 'was/were, been'), (3, 'take', 'took, taken'), (4, 'see', 'saw, seen'), (5, 'write', 'wrote, written') ) AS v(pos, question, answer) ON true WHERE d.title = 'Английские неправильные глаголы' ORDER BY v.pos;
INSERT INTO card (deck_id, type, question, answer, created_at, updated_at) SELECT d.id, 'NORMAL', v.question, v.answer, now(), now() FROM deck d JOIN (VALUES (1, 'Франция', 'Париж'), (2, 'Япония', 'Токио'), (3, 'Канада', 'Оттава'), (4, 'Австралия', 'Канберра'), (5, 'Бразилия', 'Бразилиа') ) AS v(pos, question, answer) ON true WHERE d.title = 'Столицы мира' ORDER BY v.pos;
